Question: The risk of withdrawal delirium is greatest following discontinuation of which of the following substances

Options: 
A. Ecstasy
B. Marijuana
C. Alcohol
D. Cocaine
E. Tobacco
F. Phenobarbital
G. Heroin
H. LSD
I. Methamphetamine
J. Caffeine

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
